verdict.rationale: Plaid documents that Identity Verification verifies identification documents and markets authenticating 'global ID documents'. However, the evidence never enumerates supported countries or document types, and no published supported-document list appears. missing for 10: published list of supported countries, enumerated document types (passports, national IDs, driver licenses, residence permits), independent corroboration of coverage breadth.

support.subject: As an ops lead, the platform verifies government IDs from a documented breadth of countries and document types — passports, national IDs, driver licenses, residence permits — with the supported list published

citations.quote: Using Identity Verification, you can verify identification documents, phone numbers, name, date of birth, ID numbers, addresses, and more.
Verify that global ID documents are authentic and valid.
